title: GUITestScape: Towards Open-set Evaluation on Exploratory GUI Testing
abstract: arXiv:2605.29532v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Exploratory GUI testing is a particularly demanding setting for MLLM agents: without predefined test scripts, an agent must autonomously navigate an application and discover defects through its own interaction. However, current evaluation falls short on two fronts. First, existing benchmarks focus almost exclusively on interaction defects, leaving display defects outside the evaluation frame. Second, evaluation protocols are bound to predefined defect annotations, collapsing the testing process into a single end-state judgment that conflates qualitatively distinct failure modes. To address these challenges, we present GUITestScape, an interactive benchmark covering 61 real-world Android applications and 508 preset defects spanning interaction and display types, and introduce GUIJudge, an open-set evaluator that decomposes an agent's testing trajectory into independently diagnosable capabilities. translated_title: GUITestScape：面向探索式GUI测试的开集评估
translated_abstract: 探索式GUI测试对多模态大语言模型（MLLM）智能体而言是一项极具挑战性的任务：在没有预定义测试脚本的情况下，智能体必须自主地在应用程序中导航，并通过自身的交互来发现缺陷。然而，当前的评估在两个方面存在不足。首先，现有基准几乎完全聚焦于交互缺陷，将显示缺陷排除在评估框架之外。其次，评估协议受限于预定义的缺陷标注，将测试过程压缩为单一的终态判断，从而混淆了性质上截然不同的失败模式。为应对这些挑战，我们提出了GUITestScape，这是一个交互式基准，涵盖61个真实世界的Android应用程序以及508个横跨交互与显示类型的预设缺陷；同时引入GUIJudge，一个开集评估器，它将智能体的测试轨迹分解为可独立诊断的多项能力。实验结果表明……
tldr: 该论文提出了涵盖61个真实Android应用和508个交互与显示类缺陷的交互式基准GUITestScape，以及开集评估器GUIJudge，通过将智能体的测试轨迹分解为可独立诊断的能力，实现对探索式GUI测试更全面、更细粒度的评估。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces GUITestScape, an interactive benchmark covering 61 real-world Android apps and 508 interaction and display defects, along with GUIJudge, an open-set evaluator that decomposes an agent's testing trajectory into independently diagnosable capabilities for more comprehensive evaluation of exploratory GUI testing.
